# package selection

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-modbus-trace/selection"
```

Package selection is the one transaction predicate the CLI, the exporters and applications share. A selection decides what is listed or exported; it never changes decoding.

## Types

### type Selection

```go
type Selection struct {
	Servers   []netip.AddrPort // a zero port matches any port
	Clients   []netip.Addr
	Units     []uint8
	Conns     []uint32
	Functions []uint8
	Statuses  []string
	Classes   []string // read, write, other
	Require   []string // quality flags a transaction must have
	Exclude   []string // quality flags it must not have
	// Time window, inclusive start, exclusive end. From and To are
	// absolute; FromOffset and ToOffset are offsets from the first packet
	// of the trace and are resolved with Resolve.
	From, To             *time.Time
	FromOffset, ToOffset *time.Duration
	// Address range: transactions touching [Start, End] in Space.
	Space      mbtcp.Space
	Start, End uint16
}
```

Selection selects transactions. Empty fields select everything.

#### func (Selection) Empty

```go
func (s *Selection) Empty() bool
```

Empty reports a selection that selects everything.

#### func (Selection) Match

```go
func (s *Selection) Match(t *model.Transaction) bool
```

Match reports whether a transaction is selected.

#### func (Selection) MatchConn

```go
func (s *Selection) MatchConn(id uint32, client, server netip.AddrPort) bool
```

MatchConn reports whether events of a connection can be selected at all (servers, clients, connections).

#### func (Selection) Resolve

```go
func (s *Selection) Resolve(first time.Time)
```

Resolve turns the offsets into absolute times, given the time of the trace's first packet.

#### func (Selection) String

```go
func (s *Selection) String() string
```

String returns the canonical form of the selection ("" for everything), used in export headers and reports.
